azure-compliance.control.ad_admin_portal.reason: Includes MFA control but ignores grant-controls operator and alternative controls. Enabled All-users admin-portals policy with OR[mfa,compliantDevice] passes despite MFA not being required; exclusions also remain unevaluated.

source_review.pinned_sql:
with distinct_tenant as (
      select
        distinct tenant_id,
        display_name,
        subscription_id,
        _ctx
      from
        azure_tenant
    ),
    conditional_access_policy as (
      select
        tenant_id,
        count(*) as conditional_access_policy_count
      from
        azuread_conditional_access_policy
      where
        users -> 'includeUsers' ? 'All'
        and applications -> 'includeApplications' ? 'MicrosoftAdminPortals'
        and built_in_controls @> '[1]'::jsonb
        and state = 'enabled'
      group
        by tenant_id
    )
    select
      t.tenant_id as resource,
      case
        when conditional_access_policy_count > 0 then 'ok'
        else 'alarm'
      end as status,
      case
        when conditional_access_policy_count > 0 then t.display_name || ' has conditional access policy that requires MFA for All users (or admin roles) when accessing admin portals.'
        else t.display_name || ' does not have a conditional access policy that requires MFA for All users (or admin roles) when accessing admin portals.'
      end as reason,
      t.tenant_id
      ${replace(local.common_dimensions_subscription_id_qualifier_sql, "__QUALIFIER__", "t.")}
    from
      distinct_tenant as t
      left join conditional_access_policy as p on p.tenant_id = t.tenant_id;

azure-compliance.control.appservice_func.reason: Only flags an explicit Any/Allow restriction. Complete empty IP restrictions with documented default Allow and Enabled public network produces OK although requests remain publicly allowed. Selector ignores actual default action and ordered rule enforcement.

source_review.pinned_sql:
with public_function_app as (
      select
        id
      from
        azure_app_service_function_app,
        jsonb_array_elements(configuration -> 'properties' -> 'ipSecurityRestrictions') as r
      where
        r ->> 'ipAddress' = 'Any'
        and r ->> 'action' = 'Allow'
    )
    select
      fa.id as resource,
      case
        when p.id is null then 'ok'
        else 'alarm'
      end as status,
      case
        when p.id is null then name || ' not publicly accessible.'
        else name || ' publicly accessible.'
      end as reason
      ${replace(local.tag_dimensions_qualifier_sql, "__QUALIFIER__", "fa.")}
      ${replace(local.common_dimensions_qualifier_sql, "__QUALIFIER__", "fa.")}
      ${replace(local.common_dimensions_qualifier_subscription_sql, "__QUALIFIER__", "sub.")}
    from
      azure_app_service_function_app fa
      left join public_function_app as p on p.id = fa.id
      left join azure_subscription as sub on sub.subscription_id = fa.subscription_id;
